sections.text_helper: Section 6.4.1 "About option bytes" in chapter 6 (Embedded flash memory (FLASH)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 149.
sections.section_content:
The FLASH includes a set of nonvolatile option bytes. They are loaded at power-on reset
and can be read and modified only through configuration registers.
This section documents:
• When option bytes are loaded.
• How application software can modify them.
• The detailed list of option bytes, together with their initial values (before the first option
byte change, user default configuration).
